correctness.rationale: Degree preservation and the published tangency graph force every arrangement automorphism to fix \(C_1\) and preserve \(\{C_2,C_3\}\). For a transformation fixing the three conics individually, the relative operators have spectrum \(\{1/3,1,1\}\); similarity to a scalar multiple forces scalar \(1\), hence preservation of the \(X\)- and \(Y\)-axes. The transformation is therefore a coordinate sign change. Adjoining \(X\leftrightarrow Y\) gives exactly eight conic-triple symmetries. Exact line action leaves stabilizer orders \(2\) and \(4\), with groups \(C_2\) and \(C_2\times C_2\).
